records.source: A night theme is one choice that moves three things at once: the colours the interface is painted in (:data:`spacr.qt.theme.THEMES` grows by ten because of this module), which ambient animation runs behind it and in which colours (:mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.ambient`), and which set of sounds spaCR plays if the user has ever switched sound on (:mod:`spacr.qt.sound_synth`). records.label: spacr.qt.resonance#5
records.source: WHY A LATTICE AND NOT AN EVALUATION PER PARTICLE. Eight relaxation rounds over 1 300 particles is 10 400 evaluations of eight trigonometric functions each if the field is evaluated where the particle is; on a 128x128 lattice it is four outer products, once, and then 10 400 integer lookups. Measured on this machine, eight rounds over 1 300 particles: 0.61 ms with the lattice against 0.76 ms without it, which is a modest 1.26x -- the point is not the ratio today but that the FIELD's share stops depending on the particle count at all, so density can be raised without the trigonometry following it.
records.context: Why a lattice and not an evaluation per particle. records.translation: 为什么使用网格而不是对每个粒子单独求值。如果在粒子所在位置对场求值，那么对 1 300 个粒子进行八轮松弛就需要 10 400 次求值，每次包含八个三角函数；而在 128x128 的网格上，只需一次性进行四次外积，然后进行 10 400 次整数查找。在本机上测得，对 1 300 个粒子进行八轮计算：使用网格时为 0.61 ms，不使用时为 0.76 ms，只快了 1.26x——重点不在于目前的比例，而在于场计算的开销完全不再取决于粒子数量，因此可以提高密度而无需让三角函数计算随之增加。

records.label: spacr.qt.resonance#6
records.source: AND WHY THE FIGURE IS RECOMPUTED FROM A FIXED START EVERY FRAME RATHER THAN CARRIED FORWARD. Every ambient engine promises that a frame is a pure function of ``(seed, clock, size)`` -- ``test_the_clock_alone_decides_the _frame`` steps one engine twelve times and jumps another straight to the same clock and demands the same picture, and ``test_the_backdrop_survives_a_run`` shades the same clock on two threads and compares the bytes. A particle simulation carried forward from frame to frame satisfies neither. Relaxation from a seeded start does, costs 0.61 ms, and has the better behaviour besides: the figure always belongs to the sound that is playing now rather than to the last few seconds of it.
records.context: And why the figure is recomputed from a fixed start every frame rather than carried forward. Every ambient engine promises that a frame is a pure function of ``(seed, clock, size)`` -- ``test_the_clock_alone_decides_the _frame`` steps one engine twelve times and jumps another straight to the same clock and demands the same picture, and ``test_the_backdrop_survives_a_run`` shades the same clock on two threads and compares the bytes. A particle simulation carried forward from frame to frame satisfies neither. Relaxation from a seeded start does, costs 0.61 ms, and has the better behaviour besides: the figure always belongs to the sound that is playing now rather than to the last few seconds of it.
records.translation: 以及为什么每一帧都从固定的起点重新计算图形，而不是延续上一帧。每个环境动画引擎都保证一帧是 ``(seed, clock, size)`` 的纯函数——``test_the_clock_alone_decides_the _frame`` 会让一个引擎步进十二次，并让另一个引擎直接跳到相同的时钟，要求得到相同的画面；``test_the_backdrop_survives_a_run`` 会在两个线程上对同一时钟进行着色并比较字节。逐帧延续的粒子模拟两者都无法满足。从带种子的起点进行松弛则可以满足，耗时 0.61 ms，而且行为还更好：图形总是属于当前正在播放的声音，而不是最后几秒钟的声音。

records.source: ALSO THE ONE PLACE A SECTION'S VISIBILITY IS DECIDED. Maturity is not the only reason a category is not on the form -- a category every one of whose settings needs a z axis is not on a flat plate's form either -- and two functions each calling ``setVisible`` on the same card is how a card comes back the next time Preferences is saved. So the dimension switches are answered here as well, and the settings search hands visibility back to this method for the same reason. A heading the object rule holds back, because the run has none of its objects, stays hidden here too.
records.context: Also the one place a section's visibility is decided. Maturity is not the only reason a category is not on the form -- a category every one of whose settings needs a z axis is not on a flat laboratory microplate's form either -- and two functions each calling ``setVisible`` on the same card is how a card comes back the next time Preferences is saved. So the dimension switches are answered here as well, and the settings search hands visibility back to this method for the same reason. A heading the object rule holds back, because the processing session has none of its objects, stays hidden here too.
records.translation: 这也是唯一决定某个分区是否可见的地方。成熟度并不是某个类别不出现在表单上的唯一原因——所有设置都需要 z 轴的类别，也不会出现在平面板的表单上——而两个函数各自对同一张卡片调用 ``setVisible``，正是卡片在下次保存偏好设置时又重新出现的原因。因此，维度开关也在这里处理，设置搜索出于同样的原因会把可见性交还给此方法。对象规则所隐藏的标题（因为本次运行没有其对应的对象）在这里也保持隐藏。
